# vcp_vmware_disk_types (Data Source)

List available VMware Cloud disk types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vcp_vmware_disk_types" "in_location" {
  location_id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_id` (Number) Filter disk types by location ID.

### Read-Only

- `disk_types` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disk_types))

- `max_gb` (Number)
